about: BadmintonRecs starter catalog (2026-10-23): current badminton rackets from Yonex (Astrox, Nanoflare, Arcsaber), Victor (Thruster, Auraspeed, DriveX, Jetspeed) and Li-Ning (Axforce, Halbertec, Aeronaut, BladeX, Tectonic). Every value was read on 2026-10-23 from the page in sources; anything that page does not state is blank. Yonex: yonex.com product pages (flex, weight/grip, stringing advice; Yonex lists no balance in its specs). Victor: Victor's own regional site th.victorsport.com (weight/grip and string tension; flex only where the page shows Victor's 5-dot stiff-to-flexible scale; no balance). Victor limits listed without a weight label follow the order of the weight classes on the page. Li-Ning: Li-Ning India's official store in.lining.studio (balance, balance point, shaft flexibility, maximum tension; 3U/4U/5U listings of one model are one entry). Names follow the maker's own model names without colour codes (Victor's trailing colour letters, e.g. 'THRUSTER RYUGA II PRO B', are dropped); signature, collaboration, junior and gift-box editions are left out. Columns: shape = series, weight = weight classes, balance = balance as the maker states it, core = shaft flex in the maker's own wording, surface = string tension limit or range.
